Savage Desert (cut mission)

Savage Desert is scenario 1 of a series of six scenarios of Etherlords that were never released. The texts of the series (MT_S01 to MT_S06) are filled in only in the English edition, which also has each briefing as the text of a spoken one; in the Russian edition the same texts are empty. No map of either edition uses them.

Briefing

The Chaots have just crushed the Synthets' elite troops, and only one enemy is left in their way: a renegade Cyclops, entrenched with a strong guard in the north-eastern mountains. The Chaots are to destroy him.

In the game's own wiki, the full briefing from your copy of the game appears here (the Russian edition has none):

The conditions, as the English edition words them:

ConditionText
ObjectiveDefeat Cyclops
VictoryDefeat Cyclops
Defeatnone

What the program still knows

This is the only scenario of the series the program itself names: it knows the map smission01 and gives it a rule of its own. The mission is won when a human player's hero defeats the Cyclops, and the usual victory, defeating every enemy, does not count on it. Nothing else of the map is left.

The series

The six scenarios: Savage Desert · Balance of Terror · First Strike · Ice Trap · Dragon Lake · Synthets Menace.
